title: You're Already Playing Your Own Worst Game #Shorts
topic: Dark Psychology: Manipulation tactics people secretly use in conversations
script: You think you're in control, but are you? People unknowingly manipulate themselves in conversations, setting them up for the exact opposite of what they want. They mirror your words, use your emotions, and even agree to disagree. It's a subtle game of cat and mouse, where the goal is to keep the conversation going, not to find the truth. You're trapped in a never-ending cycle of yes-man and yes-woman. So, the next time you're in a conversation, ask yourself: are you the puppet, or the puppeteer?
